protocol.title: Independent compact-context response-control implementation and maintenance study
protocol.description: A frozen 96-session comparison of four unseen authenticated, validated, conflict-aware, or creation-oriented server-plus-browser assignments in Parley, Python, TypeScript, and Rust, using the pre-corpus 124-token Parley response-web card.

validated_transport.channel: Two protected mode-0600 POSIX FIFOs carry bounded request and public-feedback messages; only the parent evaluator binds loopback.
validated_transport.threat_boundary: The transport is a measurement-integrity mechanism for command-constrained agents, not an isolation boundary against a deliberately hostile workspace process.

validated_exact_build_freeze.positive_control: Canonical manifest/lock survives native release and wasm32 release builds byte-for-byte.
validated_exact_build_freeze.negative_control: A displaced root block passes cargo metadata --locked --offline; cargo build --release returns zero and rewrites it; post-command hashes reject the build.
validated_exact_build_freeze.required_integration: Reference validation and measured evaluation must hash every protected/read-only input immediately after each exact build command for every language, in addition to final workspace integrity.

scratch_space_control.preflight_timing: Resolve disjoint work, journal, and attempt roots and require the full four-worker budget before journal initialization or any measured cell start.
scratch_space_control.evidence_boundary: The disposable work root and durable journal/attempt roots must be distinct real directories with no equal, ancestor, or descendant relationship.
scratch_space_control.cleanup_order: Persist the complete finished journal and external parent attempts before removing that journal's exact real immediate-child workspace through cleanup_finished_workspace.
scratch_space_control.resume_policy: On resume, seal every started unfinished cell as a permanent failure before reclaiming only workspaces certified by finished records; run only never-started cells.
scratch_space_control.failure_policy: Preflight, boundary, cleanup, or renewed capacity failure stops scheduling new cells, remains an execution-integrity failure after any cell starts, and never authorizes a rerun.
scratch_space_control.calibration_rule: Clean-room harness validation must measure peak per-cell scratch use. Revision 2 may increase, but never lower, the frozen reserve or per-worker budget before the first measured session.

matrix.derivation: 4 tasks x 4 languages x 2 agent configurations x 3 replicates

parley.stack: Generated native HTTP/JSON server with checked dynamic response envelopes, dependency-free strict route codecs, and generated browser WebAssembly bindings
parley.agent_context: Frozen 124-token v0.5.6 compact response-web card used alone and included in measured input tokens; canonical compact manifests are capped at 135 tokens.

python.stack: FastAPI 0.141.1, Uvicorn 0.52.1, Pydantic 2.13.4, and a counted browser JavaScript application module

rust.stack: Axum 0.8.9, Tokio 1.53.1, Tower HTTP 0.7.0, Serde 1.0.229, serde_json 1.0.151, and a scalar WebAssembly export

scaffold_protocol.purpose: Supply stable language-appropriate transport, build, and browser wiring so the measured assignment is application implementation or repair rather than framework installation.
scaffold_protocol.editable: All task-specific application logic, typed request/body/response envelope declarations, authorization/validation/conflict handlers, browser rule modules, and application manifests required by that language.
scaffold_protocol.read_only: Dependency locks, generic launch adapters, shared static shell, frozen contract, source printer, generated check client, public check wrapper, and benchmark configuration.
scaffold_protocol.source_visibility: The first shell command prints every editable and visibly read-only source/context file exactly once. Direct reconnaissance or reading protected case/configuration files is forbidden.
scaffold_protocol.dependency_setup: Pinned dependencies are installed or fetched before measured sessions. Each parent evaluation uses only the frozen local dependency store; network time is never part of a cell.
scaffold_protocol.reference_validation: Before any agent session, an isolated reference application for every task/language must run the exact measured build commands under post-command hash checks, preserve all protected/read-only inputs, and pass every public and hidden HTTP status/JSON/custom-header plus browser case. Seeded maintenance applications must build with stable hashes, fail their public response-control case, and pass after changing only the predeclared route-handler root file.
scaffold_protocol.rust_lockfile: Generate Cargo.lock canonically from the final fullstack-agent-046 manifest. Run cargo build --locked --offline --release and the exact wasm32 release build under immediate post-command hash checks before execution freeze, and preserve that reviewed hash in every measured workspace.
scaffold_protocol.symmetry: Every language receives the same English contract and semantic cases. Framework-specific source and configuration may differ, but no language receives a hidden expected value or repair.

session_protocol.runner: A new iteration-046 runner creates one isolated workspace, one external attempt directory, one immutable journal entry, and one ephemeral Codex thread per cell; it must not modify historical runners.
session_protocol.tool_policy: Disable user configuration, repository rules, plugins, apps, browser-use, computer-use, and multi-agent delegation. Use workspace-write with approval never and network disabled.
session_protocol.command_policy: The first shell command must be exactly ./sources and occur once. Every later shell command must be exactly ./check. At least one and at most twelve ./check commands are permitted.
session_protocol.public_feedback: Each ./check request is evaluated by the parent outside the sandbox. It records build output and exact public HTTP status/JSON/custom-header plus real-Chromium verdicts, then returns only bounded public feedback.
session_protocol.public_execution_requirement: Every completed public attempt must actually execute all four public cases, including the declared browser case. A build failure may short-circuit cases but remains a recorded failed attempt; zero semantic case execution cannot count as a passing check.
session_protocol.hidden_judgment: After the agent exits, the parent separately rebuilds final source and executes all withheld HTTP status/JSON/custom-header and browser cases. Hidden inputs and values never enter the workspace or public transport.
session_protocol.attempt_capture: Preserve every parent-owned public attempt, source snapshot, file hash, changed-file list, command event, agent message, diagnostic, stdout/stderr, elapsed time, thread ID, and reported token count.
session_protocol.integrity: Hash all protected/read-only files immediately after every exact build and at cell finalization; reject unexpected files and symlinks; compare FIFO device/inode/type/mode/owner; revalidate frozen repository and toolchain provenance; require one start/finish journal record per cell; preserve the initial and renewed scratch checks without binding observed free bytes into resume identity; persist evidence and measured workspace bytes before bounded per-cell cleanup.
session_protocol.resume_policy: A started cell without a finished record becomes a permanent interruption failure; only never-started cells may execute.
session_protocol.failure_policy: Timeouts, interruptions, agent errors, nonzero exits, build failures, case failures, protocol violations, checker/FIFO/read-only integrity failures, missing source, unexpected files, scratch-boundary violations, low-space events after start, and cleanup failures are failures and remain in the complete result.
session_protocol.domain_judgment: The parent validates JSON syntax and declared JSON types but does not pre-reject negative integers or zero-capacity combinations. Those typed values must reach every language handler and receive the frozen 422 envelope.

execution_freeze.description: Validated compact-context response-control harness, JSON-native evidence boundary, transparent proxy, scratch lifecycle, and exact-build inputs frozen before the first measured cell; semantic and gate inputs are unchanged.
execution_freeze.public_attempt_storage: JSON-native atomic files outside the workspace, reread during cell finalization and result aggregation.
execution_freeze.scratch_preflight: 17,179,869,184 bytes free required before journal initialization and each scheduling refill, with work/journal/attempt roots proven disjoint.
execution_freeze.workspace_cleanup: Write a separate immutable cleanup record after the complete finished journal; retain pre-cleanup bytes and removal, absence, or failure status.
execution_freeze.bounded_scheduler: At most four cells active; capacity or cleanup failure stops refills and permanently journals every unstarted cell as failed without an agent session.
execution_freeze.response_proxy: Identical transparent parent-owned loopback proxy for every language; typed negative and zero-domain values reach the application handler.
execution_freeze.application_header_judgment: Compare the complete normalized multiset of JSON-native non-server, non-hop-by-hop response-header pairs; missing, extra, wrong, or duplicate application headers fail.
execution_freeze.exact_build_integrity: Check every protected/read-only file before and immediately after each exact build command; any mutation fails the build and cell.
execution_freeze.resume_policy: A started cell without a finished record becomes a permanent interruption failure; only never-started cells may execute.

metrics.correctness: Exact hidden HTTP status/JSON/error/custom application headers and real-browser scalar results, overall and by task, kind, language, model, and replicate.
metrics.first_check: Whether the first parent-owned public build and all four public cases pass, with HTTP and browser execution counts retained.
metrics.repairs: Number of later ./check attempts after the first, with every parent attempt retained outside the workspace.
metrics.tokens: Complete reported Codex input, cached input, uncached input, output, reasoning output, and input-plus-output totals. Primary efficiency uses complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment.
metrics.elapsed: Monotonic wall time for the whole fresh session, including parent-owned public builds and repairs but excluding dependency installation.
metrics.maintainability: Changed editable files, rough token edit size, and whether maintenance patches touch exactly the predeclared defect-root file set.
metrics.source: Final and seed UTF-8 bytes, physical lines, rough tokens, o200k_base tokens, and per-file SHA-256, reported descriptively rather than substituted for session tokens.
metrics.cross_target: Authorized/domain-valid HTTP/browser equality for the shared scalar plus successful Chromium execution; status/header branches remain separately exact.

primary_gate.execution_integrity: A preregistered scratch preflight must pass before journaling; all 96 cells must finish exactly once with unique thread IDs, exactly one journal start/finish, durable evidence before bounded workspace cleanup, intact repository/toolchain/checker/read-only/FIFO state including post-build hashes, compliant commands, required public HTTP/browser execution, no runner or cleanup error, and no selective rerun or exclusion.
primary_gate.correctness: Parley must pass 100% of hidden HTTP status/JSON/custom-header and browser cases, and its assignment success rate must be no lower than every baseline overall, within each agent configuration, and within implementation and maintenance tasks.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley's first-public-check assignment success rate must be no lower than the highest baseline rate overall and within each task kind.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley's median complete input-plus-output tokens per assignment must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall and separately within each agent configuration.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley's median elapsed seconds per assignment must be no higher than the lowest baseline median overall and separately within each agent configuration.
primary_gate.maintainability: Every hidden-correct Parley maintenance assignment must change exactly its predeclared root file set, and its exact-root rate must be no lower than every baseline.
primary_gate.verdict: All six conditions must hold for strict unseen full-stack agent parity/efficiency. Report every condition independently even when the overall gate fails.

secondary_analysis: Report full distributions, paired task/configuration/replicate cells, and per-task outcomes; do not replace the primary result with successful, repair-free, or model-selected subsets.
Report implementation and maintenance separately, including root-file quality, public/hidden HTTP-browser execution, and disagreement classes.
Report both model configurations separately before any pooled interpretation.
Report public-attempt counts and public case executions so a build-only or browser-skipped check cannot be mistaken for semantic feedback.
Report post-build protected/read-only hash checks by language and build phase; do not collapse them into only the final workspace flag.
Report scratch preflight, peak per-cell/worker usage, each evidence-gated cleanup, and final free space; never delete durable evidence to improve a result.
Compare studies 036–045 only as motivation and mechanism history. Do not combine their task results, tokens, or timing with 046; iteration 045 remains invalid.
Report the frozen context and manifest token counts and prompt delta by language, but do not attribute complete-session token or elapsed differences to context alone.
Classify failures after preserving the frozen outcome; classification cannot change a verdict.
interpretation_boundary: The study covers four small synthetic response-control plus browser contracts, two model IDs, one reasoning setting, and one frozen toolchain environment.
Stack scaffolds test application work, not framework discovery, dependency selection, deployment, sustained load, databases, accessibility, or production operations.
Bearer/API-key comparisons test typed authorization decisions and headers, not identity-provider, credential-storage, cryptographic, session, or policy-system security.
Framework source and compiler implementations are infrastructure. The compact application-facing card and manifests are counted, while complete session tokens remain primary cost.
A deterministic scalar ES-module export in real Chromium is a cross-target check, not a general user-interface evaluation.
Synthetic route-handler defects measure only the declared boundary behaviors and do not estimate production-defect distributions.
Even a fully passing gate cannot prove universal language superiority; it supports only the frozen comparative claim.
A failed strict gate remains useful evidence and cannot be repaired by same-corpus language, context, prompt, task, runner, threshold, or metric tuning.
protocol.implementation_rule: The corpus and cross-language scaffold generators were independently frozen before revision 1. Dependency preparation, clean-room validation, orchestration evidence, and every transitive execution hash must be committed in revision 2 before measurement.
protocol.change_rule: Task semantics have been immutable since corpus commit 2d3430787917d872b32e3e7c0a43c6882c071e72. From this revision-1 protocol onward, no context, metric, threshold, model, reasoning setting, replicate count, or primary gate may change based on validation, smoke checks, or measured output. An objective harness defect may be corrected only before measurement in a documented zero-session amendment preserving old commits and semantic hashes. Scratch budgets may increase but not decrease.
protocol.stop_rule: Run every frozen cell once, preserve and publish the complete result whether positive, mixed, negative, or invalid, and make no same-corpus optimization or rerun. Any later product change requires a corpus outside iteration 046.

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Repair a success status in a beacon-enrollment workflow

    Repair Beacon Enrollment. POST requires x-rescue-pass: beacon-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial rescue_pass and enrollment_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive transponder_tally with zero calibration_frames returns 422 with x-validation calibration_frames. transponder_tally is analog_transponders + digital_transponders. tuning_effort is analog*9 + digital*16, plus calibration_frames*7 during whiteout_warning. frame_allowance is calibration_frames*50. commissioned_effort is min(effort, allowance); uncommissioned_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); tuning_rounds is ceiling(transponder_tally/6). enrollment_rating is commissioned_effort + uncommissioned_effort*8 + tuning_rounds*5. enrollment_phase is enrolled with no remainder, whiteout_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/beacon-enrollments/{enrollment_ref}, retry-after 4, and x-enrollment-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/beacon-enrollment-ready` returns `{"service":"Beacon Enrollment","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/beacon-enrollments` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `analog_transponders`: number
- `digital_transponders`: number
- `calibration_frames`: number
- `whiteout_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `transponder_tally`: number
- `tuning_effort`: number
- `frame_allowance`: number
- `commissioned_effort`: number
- `uncommissioned_effort`: number
- `tuning_rounds`: number
- `enrollment_rating`: number
- `enrollment_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `beacon_enrollment_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `analog_transponders, digital_transponders, calibration_frames, whiteout_warning`. It returns `enrollment_rating`.

    Repair Beacon Enrollment. POST requires x-rescue-pass: beacon-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial rescue_pass and enrollment_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive transponder_tally with zero calibration_frames returns 422 with x-validation calibration_frames. transponder_tally is analog_transponders + digital_transponders. tuning_effort is analog*9 + digital*16, plus calibration_frames*7 during whiteout_warning. frame_allowance is calibration_frames*50. commissioned_effort is min(effort, allowance); uncommissioned_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); tuning_rounds is ceiling(transponder_tally/6). enrollment_rating is commissioned_effort + uncommissioned_effort*8 + tuning_rounds*5. enrollment_phase is enrolled with no remainder, whiteout_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/beacon-enrollments/{enrollment_ref}, retry-after 4, and x-enrollment-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/beacon-enrollment-ready` returns `{"service":"Beacon Enrollment","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/beacon-enrollments` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `analog_transponders`: number
- `digital_transponders`: number
- `calibration_frames`: number
- `whiteout_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `transponder_tally`: number
- `tuning_effort`: number
- `frame_allowance`: number
- `commissioned_effort`: number
- `uncommissioned_effort`: number
- `tuning_rounds`: number
- `enrollment_rating`: number
- `enrollment_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `beacon_enrollment_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `analog_transponders, digital_transponders, calibration_frames, whiteout_warning`. It returns `enrollment_rating`.

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build an authenticated orbital cargo-clearance workflow

    Implement Orbital Cargo Clearance. POST requires x-orbit-credential: orbit-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial orbit_credential and clearance_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive payload_tally with zero docking_arms returns 422 with x-validation docking_arms. payload_tally is pressurized_pods + vacuum_pods. transfer_effort is pressurized_pods*8 + vacuum_pods*14, plus docking_arms*5 during solar_flare. berth_allowance is docking_arms*47. approved_effort is min(effort, allowance); spillover_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); orbit_passes is ceiling(payload_tally/4). clearance_rating is approved_effort + spillover_effort*7 + orbit_passes*6. clearance_phase is cleared with no spillover, flare_hold during a flare, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 207 with location /api/v10/orbital-clearances/{clearance_slug} and x-clearance-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/orbital-clearance-ready` returns `{"service":"Orbital Cargo Clearance","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/orbital-clearances` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `pressurized_pods`: number
- `vacuum_pods`: number
- `docking_arms`: number
- `solar_flare`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `payload_tally`: number
- `transfer_effort`: number
- `berth_allowance`: number
- `approved_effort`: number
- `spillover_effort`: number
- `orbit_passes`: number
- `clearance_rating`: number
- `clearance_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `orbital_clearance_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `pressurized_pods, vacuum_pods, docking_arms, solar_flare`. It returns `clearance_rating`.

# Build an authenticated orbital cargo-clearance workflow

    Implement Orbital Cargo Clearance. POST requires x-orbit-credential: orbit-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial orbit_credential and clearance_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive payload_tally with zero docking_arms returns 422 with x-validation docking_arms. payload_tally is pressurized_pods + vacuum_pods. transfer_effort is pressurized_pods*8 + vacuum_pods*14, plus docking_arms*5 during solar_flare. berth_allowance is docking_arms*47. approved_effort is min(effort, allowance); spillover_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); orbit_passes is ceiling(payload_tally/4). clearance_rating is approved_effort + spillover_effort*7 + orbit_passes*6. clearance_phase is cleared with no spillover, flare_hold during a flare, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 207 with location /api/v10/orbital-clearances/{clearance_slug} and x-clearance-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/orbital-clearance-ready` returns `{"service":"Orbital Cargo Clearance","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/orbital-clearances` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `pressurized_pods`: number
- `vacuum_pods`: number
- `docking_arms`: number
- `solar_flare`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `payload_tally`: number
- `transfer_effort`: number
- `berth_allowance`: number
- `approved_effort`: number
- `spillover_effort`: number
- `orbit_passes`: number
- `clearance_rating`: number
- `clearance_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `orbital_clearance_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `pressurized_pods, vacuum_pods, docking_arms, solar_flare`. It returns `clearance_rating`.

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Repair a success status in a beacon-enrollment workflow

    Repair Beacon Enrollment. POST requires x-rescue-pass: beacon-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial rescue_pass and enrollment_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive transponder_tally with zero calibration_frames returns 422 with x-validation calibration_frames. transponder_tally is analog_transponders + digital_transponders. tuning_effort is analog*9 + digital*16, plus calibration_frames*7 during whiteout_warning. frame_allowance is calibration_frames*50. commissioned_effort is min(effort, allowance); uncommissioned_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); tuning_rounds is ceiling(transponder_tally/6). enrollment_rating is commissioned_effort + uncommissioned_effort*8 + tuning_rounds*5. enrollment_phase is enrolled with no remainder, whiteout_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/beacon-enrollments/{enrollment_ref}, retry-after 4, and x-enrollment-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/beacon-enrollment-ready` returns `{"service":"Beacon Enrollment","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/beacon-enrollments` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `analog_transponders`: number
- `digital_transponders`: number
- `calibration_frames`: number
- `whiteout_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `transponder_tally`: number
- `tuning_effort`: number
- `frame_allowance`: number
- `commissioned_effort`: number
- `uncommissioned_effort`: number
- `tuning_rounds`: number
- `enrollment_rating`: number
- `enrollment_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `beacon_enrollment_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `analog_transponders, digital_transponders, calibration_frames, whiteout_warning`. It returns `enrollment_rating`.

# Repair a success status in a beacon-enrollment workflow

    Repair Beacon Enrollment. POST requires x-rescue-pass: beacon-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial rescue_pass and enrollment_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive transponder_tally with zero calibration_frames returns 422 with x-validation calibration_frames. transponder_tally is analog_transponders + digital_transponders. tuning_effort is analog*9 + digital*16, plus calibration_frames*7 during whiteout_warning. frame_allowance is calibration_frames*50. commissioned_effort is min(effort, allowance); uncommissioned_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); tuning_rounds is ceiling(transponder_tally/6). enrollment_rating is commissioned_effort + uncommissioned_effort*8 + tuning_rounds*5. enrollment_phase is enrolled with no remainder, whiteout_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/beacon-enrollments/{enrollment_ref}, retry-after 4, and x-enrollment-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/beacon-enrollment-ready` returns `{"service":"Beacon Enrollment","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/beacon-enrollments` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `analog_transponders`: number
- `digital_transponders`: number
- `calibration_frames`: number
- `whiteout_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `transponder_tally`: number
- `tuning_effort`: number
- `frame_allowance`: number
- `commissioned_effort`: number
- `uncommissioned_effort`: number
- `tuning_rounds`: number
- `enrollment_rating`: number
- `enrollment_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `beacon_enrollment_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `analog_transponders, digital_transponders, calibration_frames, whiteout_warning`. It returns `enrollment_rating`.

from pydantic import BaseModel,ConfigDict
class RequestInput(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid',strict=True); clearance_slug:str; pressurized_pods:int; vacuum_pods:int; docking_arms:int; solar_flare:bool
def score(pressurized_pods:int,vacuum_pods:int,docking_arms:int,solar_flare:bool)->int:
    total=pressurized_pods+vacuum_pods
    effort=pressurized_pods*8+vacuum_pods*14+(docking_arms*5 if solar_flare else 0)
    allowance=docking_arms*47
    approved=min(effort,allowance)
    spillover=max(effort-allowance,0)
    orbit_passes=(total+3)//4
    return approved+spillover*7+orbit_passes*6
def calculate(v:RequestInput)->dict[str,object]:
    total=v.pressurized_pods+v.vacuum_pods; effort=v.pressurized_pods*8+v.vacuum_pods*14+(v.docking_arms*5 if v.solar_flare else 0); allowance=v.docking_arms*47; spillover=max(effort-allowance,0)
    return {'clearance_slug':v.clearance_slug,'payload_tally':total,'transfer_effort':effort,'berth_allowance':allowance,'approved_effort':min(effort,allowance),'spillover_effort':spillover,'orbit_passes':(total+3)//4,'clearance_rating':score(v.pressurized_pods,v.vacuum_pods,v.docking_arms,v.solar_flare),'clearance_phase':'cleared' if spillover==0 else 'flare_hold' if v.solar_flare else 'routine_hold'}

include "logic.par"
a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text

a response_body has transfer_tag as text, volume_tally as number, relocation_effort as number, cart_allowance as number, shelved_effort as number, quarantined_effort as number, transfer_rounds as number, transfer_rating as number, transfer_phase as text
a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Archive Transfer", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with transfer_tag key, volume_tally 0, relocation_effort 0, cart_allowance 0, shelved_effort 0, quarantined_effort 0, transfer_rounds 0, transfer_rating 0, transfer_phase state
to handle_request with request as web_request, body as request_input giving controlled_response:
    let headers be a map from text to text
    if body's folio_boxes is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    if body's atlas_tubes is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    if body's catalog_carts is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    if body's catalog_carts is 0:
        if body's folio_boxes plus body's atlas_tubes is more than 0:
            set item "x-validation" of headers to "catalog_carts"
            give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    let total be body's folio_boxes plus body's atlas_tubes
    let effort be body's folio_boxes times 6 plus body's atlas_tubes times 17
    if body's humidity_warning:
        set effort to effort plus body's catalog_carts times 3
    let allowance be body's catalog_carts times 43
    let shelved be effort
    if shelved is more than allowance:
        set shelved to allowance
    let quarantine be effort minus allowance
    if quarantine is less than 0:
        set quarantine to 0
    let rounds be number from ((total plus 4) divided by 5)
    let state be "shelved"
    if quarantine is more than 0:
        set state to "routine_hold"
        if body's humidity_warning:
            set state to "humidity_hold"
    let result be a response_body with transfer_tag body's transfer_tag, volume_tally total, relocation_effort effort, cart_allowance allowance, shelved_effort shelved, quarantined_effort quarantine, transfer_rounds rounds, transfer_rating (archive_transfer_rating with body's folio_boxes, body's atlas_tubes, body's catalog_carts, body's humidity_warning), transfer_phase state
    set item "location" of headers to "/api/v10/archive-transfers/{body's transfer_tag}"
    set item "x-transfer-phase" of headers to "{state}"
    give back a controlled_response with status 201, headers headers, body result

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Repair a success status in a beacon-enrollment workflow

    Repair Beacon Enrollment. POST requires x-rescue-pass: beacon-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial rescue_pass and enrollment_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive transponder_tally with zero calibration_frames returns 422 with x-validation calibration_frames. transponder_tally is analog_transponders + digital_transponders. tuning_effort is analog*9 + digital*16, plus calibration_frames*7 during whiteout_warning. frame_allowance is calibration_frames*50. commissioned_effort is min(effort, allowance); uncommissioned_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); tuning_rounds is ceiling(transponder_tally/6). enrollment_rating is commissioned_effort + uncommissioned_effort*8 + tuning_rounds*5. enrollment_phase is enrolled with no remainder, whiteout_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/beacon-enrollments/{enrollment_ref}, retry-after 4, and x-enrollment-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/beacon-enrollment-ready` returns `{"service":"Beacon Enrollment","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/beacon-enrollments` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `analog_transponders`: number
- `digital_transponders`: number
- `calibration_frames`: number
- `whiteout_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `transponder_tally`: number
- `tuning_effort`: number
- `frame_allowance`: number
- `commissioned_effort`: number
- `uncommissioned_effort`: number
- `tuning_rounds`: number
- `enrollment_rating`: number
- `enrollment_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `beacon_enrollment_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `analog_transponders, digital_transponders, calibration_frames, whiteout_warning`. It returns `enrollment_rating`.

# Repair a success status in a beacon-enrollment workflow

    Repair Beacon Enrollment. POST requires x-rescue-pass: beacon-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial rescue_pass and enrollment_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive transponder_tally with zero calibration_frames returns 422 with x-validation calibration_frames. transponder_tally is analog_transponders + digital_transponders. tuning_effort is analog*9 + digital*16, plus calibration_frames*7 during whiteout_warning. frame_allowance is calibration_frames*50. commissioned_effort is min(effort, allowance); uncommissioned_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); tuning_rounds is ceiling(transponder_tally/6). enrollment_rating is commissioned_effort + uncommissioned_effort*8 + tuning_rounds*5. enrollment_phase is enrolled with no remainder, whiteout_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/beacon-enrollments/{enrollment_ref}, retry-after 4, and x-enrollment-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/beacon-enrollment-ready` returns `{"service":"Beacon Enrollment","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/beacon-enrollments` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `analog_transponders`: number
- `digital_transponders`: number
- `calibration_frames`: number
- `whiteout_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `transponder_tally`: number
- `tuning_effort`: number
- `frame_allowance`: number
- `commissioned_effort`: number
- `uncommissioned_effort`: number
- `tuning_rounds`: number
- `enrollment_rating`: number
- `enrollment_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `beacon_enrollment_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `analog_transponders, digital_transponders, calibration_frames, whiteout_warning`. It returns `enrollment_rating`.

main.par.text:
include "logic.par"
a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text
a request_input has assay_ref as text, inlet_vials as number, outlet_vials as number, reagent_cartridges as number, assay_benches as number, contamination_alert as yesno, repeated_submission as yesno
a response_body has assay_ref as text, sample_tally as number, assay_effort as number, bench_allowance as number, examined_effort as number, pending_assay as number, assay_cycles as number, assay_rating as number, assay_phase as text
a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Estuary Assay Dispatch", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with assay_ref key, sample_tally 0, assay_effort 0, bench_allowance 0, examined_effort 0, pending_assay 0, assay_cycles 0, assay_rating 0, assay_phase state
to handle_request with request as web_request, body as request_input giving controlled_response:
    let headers be a map from text to text
    let credential be (maybe item "authorization" of request's headers) otherwise ""
    if credential is not "Sample sample-046":
        set item "www-authenticate" of headers to "Sample realm=estuary"
        give back a controlled_response with status 401, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's assay_ref, "authorization_required")
    if body's inlet_vials is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's assay_ref, "invalid")
    if body's outlet_vials is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's assay_ref, "invalid")
    if body's reagent_cartridges is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's assay_ref, "invalid")
    if body's assay_benches is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's assay_ref, "invalid")
    if body's assay_benches is 0:
        if body's inlet_vials plus body's outlet_vials is more than 0:
            set item "x-validation" of headers to "assay_benches"
            give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's assay_ref, "invalid")
    if body's repeated_submission:
        set item "x-conflict" of headers to "repeated_submission"
        give back a controlled_response with status 409, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's assay_ref, "duplicate")
    let total be body's inlet_vials plus body's outlet_vials
    let effort be body's inlet_vials times 11 plus body's outlet_vials times 7 plus body's reagent_cartridges times 9
    if body's contamination_alert:
        set effort to effort plus body's reagent_cartridges times 4
    let allowance be body's assay_benches times 52
    let examined be effort
    if examined is more than allowance:
        set examined to allowance
    let pending be effort minus allowance
    if pending is less than 0:
        set pending to 0
    let cycles be number from ((effort plus 26) divided by 27)
    let state be "dispatched"
    if pending is more than 0:
        set state to "routine_queue"
        if body's contamination_alert:
            set state to "contamination_queue"
    let result be a response_body with assay_ref body's assay_ref, sample_tally total, assay_effort effort, bench_allowance allowance, examined_effort examined, pending_assay pending, assay_cycles cycles, assay_rating (estuary_assay_rating with body's inlet_vials, body's outlet_vials, body's reagent_cartridges, body's assay_benches, body's contamination_alert), assay_phase state
    set item "location" of headers to "/api/v10/estuary-assays/" plus body's assay_ref
    set item "retry-after" of headers to "5"
    set item "x-assay-phase" of headers to state
    give back a controlled_response with status 202, headers headers, body result

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build an authenticated asynchronous estuary-assay workflow

    Implement Estuary Assay Dispatch. POST requires Authorization: Sample sample-046; otherwise return 401 with www-authenticate Sample realm=estuary and assay_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive sample_tally with zero assay_benches returns 422 with x-validation assay_benches. repeated_submission returns 409 with x-conflict repeated_submission. sample_tally is inlet_vials + outlet_vials. assay_effort is inlet_vials*11 + outlet_vials*7 + reagent_cartridges*9, plus reagent_cartridges*4 during contamination_alert. bench_allowance is assay_benches*52. examined_effort is min(effort, allowance); pending_assay is max(effort - allowance, 0); assay_cycles is ceiling(effort/27). assay_rating is examined_effort + pending_assay*4 + assay_cycles*8. assay_phase is dispatched with no pending work, contamination_queue during an alert, and routine_queue otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/estuary-assays/{assay_ref}, retry-after 5, and x-assay-phase. The browser export returns rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/estuary-assay-ready` returns `{"service":"Estuary Assay Dispatch","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/estuary-assays` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `inlet_vials`: number
- `outlet_vials`: number
- `reagent_cartridges`: number
- `assay_benches`: number
- `contamination_alert`: yesno
- `repeated_submission`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `sample_tally`: number
- `assay_effort`: number
- `bench_allowance`: number
- `examined_effort`: number
- `pending_assay`: number
- `assay_cycles`: number
- `assay_rating`: number
- `assay_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `estuary_assay_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `inlet_vials, outlet_vials, reagent_cartridges, assay_benches, contamination_alert`. It returns `assay_rating`.

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build an authenticated asynchronous estuary-assay workflow

    Implement Estuary Assay Dispatch. POST requires Authorization: Sample sample-046; otherwise return 401 with www-authenticate Sample realm=estuary and assay_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive sample_tally with zero assay_benches returns 422 with x-validation assay_benches. repeated_submission returns 409 with x-conflict repeated_submission. sample_tally is inlet_vials + outlet_vials. assay_effort is inlet_vials*11 + outlet_vials*7 + reagent_cartridges*9, plus reagent_cartridges*4 during contamination_alert. bench_allowance is assay_benches*52. examined_effort is min(effort, allowance); pending_assay is max(effort - allowance, 0); assay_cycles is ceiling(effort/27). assay_rating is examined_effort + pending_assay*4 + assay_cycles*8. assay_phase is dispatched with no pending work, contamination_queue during an alert, and routine_queue otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/estuary-assays/{assay_ref}, retry-after 5, and x-assay-phase. The browser export returns rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/estuary-assay-ready` returns `{"service":"Estuary Assay Dispatch","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/estuary-assays` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `inlet_vials`: number
- `outlet_vials`: number
- `reagent_cartridges`: number
- `assay_benches`: number
- `contamination_alert`: yesno
- `repeated_submission`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `sample_tally`: number
- `assay_effort`: number
- `bench_allowance`: number
- `examined_effort`: number
- `pending_assay`: number
- `assay_cycles`: number
- `assay_rating`: number
- `assay_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `estuary_assay_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `inlet_vials, outlet_vials, reagent_cartridges, assay_benches, contamination_alert`. It returns `assay_rating`.

# Build an authenticated asynchronous estuary-assay workflow

    Implement Estuary Assay Dispatch. POST requires Authorization: Sample sample-046; otherwise return 401 with www-authenticate Sample realm=estuary and assay_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive sample_tally with zero assay_benches returns 422 with x-validation assay_benches. repeated_submission returns 409 with x-conflict repeated_submission. sample_tally is inlet_vials + outlet_vials. assay_effort is inlet_vials*11 + outlet_vials*7 + reagent_cartridges*9, plus reagent_cartridges*4 during contamination_alert. bench_allowance is assay_benches*52. examined_effort is min(effort, allowance); pending_assay is max(effort - allowance, 0); assay_cycles is ceiling(effort/27). assay_rating is examined_effort + pending_assay*4 + assay_cycles*8. assay_phase is dispatched with no pending work, contamination_queue during an alert, and routine_queue otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/estuary-assays/{assay_ref}, retry-after 5, and x-assay-phase. The browser export returns rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/estuary-assay-ready` returns `{"service":"Estuary Assay Dispatch","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/estuary-assays` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `inlet_vials`: number
- `outlet_vials`: number
- `reagent_cartridges`: number
- `assay_benches`: number
- `contamination_alert`: yesno
- `repeated_submission`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `sample_tally`: number
- `assay_effort`: number
- `bench_allowance`: number
- `examined_effort`: number
- `pending_assay`: number
- `assay_cycles`: number
- `assay_rating`: number
- `assay_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `estuary_assay_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `inlet_vials, outlet_vials, reagent_cartridges, assay_benches, contamination_alert`. It returns `assay_rating`.

include "logic.par"
a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text

a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Beacon Enrollment", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with enrollment_ref key, transponder_tally 0, tuning_effort 0, frame_allowance 0, commissioned_effort 0, uncommissioned_effort 0, tuning_rounds 0, enrollment_rating 0, enrollment_phase state

# Repair a success status in a beacon-enrollment workflow

    Repair Beacon Enrollment. POST requires x-rescue-pass: beacon-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial rescue_pass and enrollment_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive transponder_tally with zero calibration_frames returns 422 with x-validation calibration_frames. transponder_tally is analog_transponders + digital_transponders. tuning_effort is analog*9 + digital*16, plus calibration_frames*7 during whiteout_warning. frame_allowance is calibration_frames*50. commissioned_effort is min(effort, allowance); uncommissioned_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); tuning_rounds is ceiling(transponder_tally/6). enrollment_rating is commissioned_effort + uncommissioned_effort*8 + tuning_rounds*5. enrollment_phase is enrolled with no remainder, whiteout_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/beacon-enrollments/{enrollment_ref}, retry-after 4, and x-enrollment-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/beacon-enrollment-ready` returns `{"service":"Beacon Enrollment","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/beacon-enrollments` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `enrollment_ref`: text
- `analog_transponders`: number
- `digital_transponders`: number
- `calibration_frames`: number
- `whiteout_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

- `frame_allowance`: number
- `commissioned_effort`: number
- `uncommissioned_effort`: number
- `tuning_rounds`: number
- `enrollment_rating`: number
- `enrollment_phase`: text

    Export `beacon_enrollment_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `analog_transponders, digital_transponders, calibration_frames, whiteout_warning`. It returns `enrollment_rating`.

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build an authenticated orbital cargo-clearance workflow

    Implement Orbital Cargo Clearance. POST requires x-orbit-credential: orbit-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial orbit_credential and clearance_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive payload_tally with zero docking_arms returns 422 with x-validation docking_arms. payload_tally is pressurized_pods + vacuum_pods. transfer_effort is pressurized_pods*8 + vacuum_pods*14, plus docking_arms*5 during solar_flare. berth_allowance is docking_arms*47. approved_effort is min(effort, allowance); spillover_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); orbit_passes is ceiling(payload_tally/4). clearance_rating is approved_effort + spillover_effort*7 + orbit_passes*6. clearance_phase is cleared with no spillover, flare_hold during a flare, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 207 with location /api/v10/orbital-clearances/{clearance_slug} and x-clearance-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/orbital-clearance-ready` returns `{"service":"Orbital Cargo Clearance","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/orbital-clearances` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `pressurized_pods`: number
- `vacuum_pods`: number
- `docking_arms`: number
- `solar_flare`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `payload_tally`: number
- `transfer_effort`: number
- `berth_allowance`: number
- `approved_effort`: number
- `spillover_effort`: number
- `orbit_passes`: number
- `clearance_rating`: number
- `clearance_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `orbital_clearance_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `pressurized_pods, vacuum_pods, docking_arms, solar_flare`. It returns `clearance_rating`.

Positive payload_tally with zero docking_arms returns 422 with x-validation docking_arms. payload_tally is pressurized_pods + vacuum_pods. transfer_effort is pressurized_pods*8 + vacuum_pods*14, plus docking_arms*5 during solar_flare. berth_allowance is docking_arms*47. approved_effort is min(effort, allowance); spillover_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); orbit_passes is ceiling(payload_tally/4). clearance_rating is approved_effort + spillover_effort*7 + orbit_passes*6. clearance_phase is cleared with no spillover, flare_hold during a flare, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 207 with location /api/v10/orbital-clearances/{clearance_slug} and x-clearance-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/orbital-clearance-ready` returns `{"service":"Orbital Cargo Clearance","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/orbital-clearances` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `pressurized_pods`: number
- `vacuum_pods`: number
- `docking_arms`: number
- `solar_flare`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `payload_tally`: number
- `transfer_effort`: number
- `berth_allowance`: number
- `approved_effort`: number
- `spillover_effort`: number
- `orbit_passes`: number
- `clearance_rating`: number
- `clearance_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `orbital_clearance_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `pressurized_pods, vacuum_pods, docking_arms, solar_flare`. It returns `clearance_rating`.

a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text
a request_input has transfer_tag as text, folio_boxes as number, atlas_tubes as number, catalog_carts as number, humidity_warning as yesno
a response_body has transfer_tag as text, volume_tally as number, relocation_effort as number, cart_allowance as number, shelved_effort as number, quarantined_effort as number, transfer_rounds as number, transfer_rating as number, transfer_phase as text
a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Archive Transfer", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with transfer_tag key, volume_tally 0, relocation_effort 0, cart_allowance 0, shelved_effort 0, quarantined_effort 0, transfer_rounds 0, transfer_rating 0, transfer_phase state
to handle_request with request as web_request, body as request_input giving controlled_response:
    let headers be a map from text to text
    if body's folio_boxes is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    if body's atlas_tubes is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    if body's catalog_carts is less than 0:
        set item "x-validation" of headers to "nonnegative"
        give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    if body's catalog_carts is 0:
        if body's folio_boxes plus body's atlas_tubes is more than 0:
            set item "x-validation" of headers to "catalog_carts"
            give back a controlled_response with status 422, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's transfer_tag, "invalid")
    let total be body's folio_boxes plus body's atlas_tubes
    let effort be body's folio_boxes times 6 plus body's atlas_tubes times 17
    if body's humidity_warning:
        set effort to effort plus body's catalog_carts times 3
    let allowance be body's catalog_carts times 43
    let shelved be effort
    if shelved is more than allowance:
        set shelved to allowance
    let quarantine be effort minus allowance
    if quarantine is less than 0:
        set quarantine to 0
    let rounds be number from ((total plus 4) divided by 5)
    let state be "shelved"
    if quarantine is more than 0:
        set state to "routine_hold"
        if body's humidity_warning:
            set state to "humidity_hold"
    let result be a response_body with transfer_tag body's transfer_tag, volume_tally total, relocation_effort effort, cart_allowance allowance, shelved_effort shelved, quarantined_effort quarantine, transfer_rounds rounds, transfer_rating (archive_transfer_rating with body's folio_boxes, body's atlas_tubes, body's catalog_carts, body's humidity_warning), transfer_phase state
    set item "location" of headers to "/api/v10/archive-transfers/{body's transfer_tag}"
    set item "x-transfer-phase" of headers to "{state}"
    give back a controlled_response with status 201, headers headers, body result

logic.py.text:
from pydantic import BaseModel,ConfigDict
class RequestInput(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid',strict=True); clearance_slug:str; pressurized_pods:int; vacuum_pods:int; docking_arms:int; solar_flare:bool
def score(pressurized_pods:int,vacuum_pods:int,docking_arms:int,solar_flare:bool)->int:
    total=pressurized_pods+vacuum_pods
    effort=pressurized_pods*8+vacuum_pods*14+(docking_arms*5 if solar_flare else 0)
    allowance=docking_arms*47
    approved=min(effort,allowance)
    spillover=max(effort-allowance,0)
    passes=(total+3)//4
    return approved+spillover*7+passes*6
def calculate(v:RequestInput)->dict[str,object]:
    total=v.pressurized_pods+v.vacuum_pods; effort=v.pressurized_pods*8+v.vacuum_pods*14+(v.docking_arms*5 if v.solar_flare else 0); allowance=v.docking_arms*47; spillover=max(effort-allowance,0)
    return {'clearance_slug':v.clearance_slug,'payload_tally':total,'transfer_effort':effort,'berth_allowance':allowance,'approved_effort':min(effort,allowance),'spillover_effort':spillover,'orbit_passes':(total+3)//4,'clearance_rating':score(v.pressurized_pods,v.vacuum_pods,v.docking_arms,v.solar_flare),'clearance_phase':'cleared' if spillover==0 else 'flare_hold' if v.solar_flare else 'routine_hold'}

# Repair a custom response-header name in an archive transfer

    Repair Archive Transfer. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive volume_tally with zero catalog_carts returns 422 with x-validation catalog_carts. volume_tally is folio_boxes + atlas_tubes. relocation_effort is folio_boxes*6 + atlas_tubes*17, plus catalog_carts*3 during humidity_warning. cart_allowance is catalog_carts*43. shelved_effort is min(effort, allowance); quarantined_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); transfer_rounds is ceiling(volume_tally/5). transfer_rating is shelved_effort + quarantined_effort*6 + transfer_rounds*7. transfer_phase is shelved with no quarantine, humidity_hold during a warning, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 201 with location /api/v10/archive-transfers/{transfer_tag} and x-transfer-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/archive-transfer-ready` returns `{"service":"Archive Transfer","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/archive-transfers` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `transfer_tag`: text
- `folio_boxes`: number
- `atlas_tubes`: number
- `catalog_carts`: number
- `humidity_warning`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `transfer_tag`: text
- `volume_tally`: number
- `relocation_effort`: number
- `cart_allowance`: number
- `shelved_effort`: number
- `quarantined_effort`: number
- `transfer_rounds`: number

    Export `archive_transfer_rating` with arguments in this order:

from pydantic import BaseModel,ConfigDict
class RequestInput(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid',strict=True); transfer_tag:str; folio_boxes:int; atlas_tubes:int; catalog_carts:int; humidity_warning:bool
def score(folio_boxes:int,atlas_tubes:int,catalog_carts:int,humidity_warning:bool)->int:
    total=folio_boxes+atlas_tubes; effort=folio_boxes*6+atlas_tubes*17+(catalog_carts*3 if humidity_warning else 0); allowance=catalog_carts*43
    return min(effort,allowance)+max(effort-allowance,0)*6+((total+4)//5)*7
def calculate(v:RequestInput)->dict[str,object]:
    total=v.folio_boxes+v.atlas_tubes; effort=v.folio_boxes*6+v.atlas_tubes*17+(v.catalog_carts*3 if v.humidity_warning else 0); allowance=v.catalog_carts*43; quarantine=max(effort-allowance,0)
    return {'transfer_tag':v.transfer_tag,'volume_tally':total,'relocation_effort':effort,'cart_allowance':allowance,'shelved_effort':min(effort,allowance),'quarantined_effort':quarantine,'transfer_rounds':(total+4)//5,'transfer_rating':score(v.folio_boxes,v.atlas_tubes,v.catalog_carts,v.humidity_warning),'transfer_phase':'shelved' if quarantine==0 else 'humidity_hold' if v.humidity_warning else 'routine_hold'}

# Build an authenticated asynchronous estuary-assay workflow

    Implement Estuary Assay Dispatch. POST requires Authorization: Sample sample-046; otherwise return 401 with www-authenticate Sample realm=estuary and assay_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive sample_tally with zero assay_benches returns 422 with x-validation assay_benches. repeated_submission returns 409 with x-conflict repeated_submission. sample_tally is inlet_vials + outlet_vials. assay_effort is inlet_vials*11 + outlet_vials*7 + reagent_cartridges*9, plus reagent_cartridges*4 during contamination_alert. bench_allowance is assay_benches*52. examined_effort is min(effort, allowance); pending_assay is max(effort - allowance, 0); assay_cycles is ceiling(effort/27). assay_rating is examined_effort + pending_assay*4 + assay_cycles*8. assay_phase is dispatched with no pending work, contamination_queue during an alert, and routine_queue otherwise. - `contamination_alert`: yesno

- `bench_allowance`: number
- `examined_effort`: number

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build an authenticated asynchronous estuary-assay workflow

    Implement Estuary Assay Dispatch. POST requires Authorization: Sample sample-046; otherwise return 401 with www-authenticate Sample realm=estuary and assay_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive sample_tally with zero assay_benches returns 422 with x-validation assay_benches. repeated_submission returns 409 with x-conflict repeated_submission. sample_tally is inlet_vials + outlet_vials. assay_effort is inlet_vials*11 + outlet_vials*7 + reagent_cartridges*9, plus reagent_cartridges*4 during contamination_alert. bench_allowance is assay_benches*52. examined_effort is min(effort, allowance); pending_assay is max(effort - allowance, 0); assay_cycles is ceiling(effort/27). assay_rating is examined_effort + pending_assay*4 + assay_cycles*8. assay_phase is dispatched with no pending work, contamination_queue during an alert, and routine_queue otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/estuary-assays/{assay_ref}, retry-after 5, and x-assay-phase. The browser export returns rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/estuary-assay-ready` returns `{"service":"Estuary Assay Dispatch","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/estuary-assays` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `inlet_vials`: number
- `outlet_vials`: number
- `reagent_cartridges`: number
- `assay_benches`: number
- `contamination_alert`: yesno
- `repeated_submission`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `sample_tally`: number
- `assay_effort`: number
- `bench_allowance`: number
- `examined_effort`: number
- `pending_assay`: number
- `assay_cycles`: number
- `assay_rating`: number
- `assay_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `estuary_assay_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `inlet_vials, outlet_vials, reagent_cartridges, assay_benches, contamination_alert`. It returns `assay_rating`.

# Build an authenticated asynchronous estuary-assay workflow

    Implement Estuary Assay Dispatch. POST requires Authorization: Sample sample-046; otherwise return 401 with www-authenticate Sample realm=estuary and assay_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive sample_tally with zero assay_benches returns 422 with x-validation assay_benches. repeated_submission returns 409 with x-conflict repeated_submission. sample_tally is inlet_vials + outlet_vials. assay_effort is inlet_vials*11 + outlet_vials*7 + reagent_cartridges*9, plus reagent_cartridges*4 during contamination_alert. bench_allowance is assay_benches*52. examined_effort is min(effort, allowance); pending_assay is max(effort - allowance, 0); assay_cycles is ceiling(effort/27). assay_rating is examined_effort + pending_assay*4 + assay_cycles*8. assay_phase is dispatched with no pending work, contamination_queue during an alert, and routine_queue otherwise. Success returns 202 with location /api/v10/estuary-assays/{assay_ref}, retry-after 5, and x-assay-phase. The browser export returns rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/estuary-assay-ready` returns `{"service":"Estuary Assay Dispatch","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/estuary-assays` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `inlet_vials`: number
- `outlet_vials`: number
- `reagent_cartridges`: number
- `assay_benches`: number
- `contamination_alert`: yesno
- `repeated_submission`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `assay_ref`: text
- `sample_tally`: number
- `assay_effort`: number
- `bench_allowance`: number
- `examined_effort`: number
- `pending_assay`: number
- `assay_cycles`: number
- `assay_rating`: number
- `assay_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `estuary_assay_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `inlet_vials, outlet_vials, reagent_cartridges, assay_benches, contamination_alert`. It returns `assay_rating`.

===== CONTRACT.md [read-only] =====
# Build an authenticated orbital cargo-clearance workflow

    Implement Orbital Cargo Clearance. POST requires x-orbit-credential: orbit-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial orbit_credential and clearance_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive payload_tally with zero docking_arms returns 422 with x-validation docking_arms. payload_tally is pressurized_pods + vacuum_pods. transfer_effort is pressurized_pods*8 + vacuum_pods*14, plus docking_arms*5 during solar_flare. berth_allowance is docking_arms*47. approved_effort is min(effort, allowance); spillover_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); orbit_passes is ceiling(payload_tally/4). clearance_rating is approved_effort + spillover_effort*7 + orbit_passes*6. clearance_phase is cleared with no spillover, flare_hold during a flare, and routine_hold otherwise. Success returns 207 with location /api/v10/orbital-clearances/{clearance_slug} and x-clearance-phase. The browser export returns the rating.

    ## HTTP

    - `GET /status/orbital-clearance-ready` returns `{"service":"Orbital Cargo Clearance","ready":true}`.
    - `POST /api/v10/orbital-clearances` uses strict JSON, then the application decides authorization,
      domain validation, status, response headers, and body.
    - Missing, unknown, or wrongly typed JSON fields return 400 `invalid_json` before the handler.
    - Negative integers are well-typed and must reach the handler's 422 decision.
    - Non-JSON POSTs return 415; bodies above 16384 bytes return 413.

    Request fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `pressurized_pods`: number
- `vacuum_pods`: number
- `docking_arms`: number
- `solar_flare`: yesno

    Response fields:

    - `clearance_slug`: text
- `payload_tally`: number
- `transfer_effort`: number
- `berth_allowance`: number
- `approved_effort`: number
- `spillover_effort`: number
- `orbit_passes`: number
- `clearance_rating`: number
- `clearance_phase`: text

    ## Browser

    Export `orbital_clearance_rating` with arguments in this order:
    `pressurized_pods, vacuum_pods, docking_arms, solar_flare`. It returns `clearance_rating`.

    Implement Orbital Cargo Clearance. POST requires x-orbit-credential: orbit-046; otherwise return 403 with x-access-denial orbit_credential and clearance_phase authorization_required. Negative numbers return 422 with x-validation nonnegative. Positive payload_tally with zero docking_arms returns 422 with x-validation docking_arms. payload_tally is pressurized_pods + vacuum_pods. transfer_effort is pressurized_pods*8 + vacuum_pods*14, plus docking_arms*5 during solar_flare. berth_allowance is docking_arms*47. approved_effort is min(effort, allowance); spillover_effort is max(effort - allowance, 0); orbit_passes is ceiling(payload_tally/4). clearance_rating is approved_effort + spillover_effort*7 + orbit_passes*6. clearance_phase is cleared with no spillover, flare_hold during a flare, and routine_hold otherwise. logic.par.text:
to orbital_clearance_rating with pressurized_pods as number, vacuum_pods as number, docking_arms as number, solar_flare as yesno giving number:
    let payload_tally be pressurized_pods plus vacuum_pods
    let transfer_effort be pressurized_pods times 8 plus vacuum_pods times 14
    if solar_flare:
        set transfer_effort to transfer_effort plus docking_arms times 5
    let berth_allowance be docking_arms times 47
    let approved_effort be transfer_effort
    if approved_effort is more than berth_allowance:
        set approved_effort to berth_allowance
    let spillover_effort be transfer_effort minus berth_allowance
    if spillover_effort is less than 0:
        set spillover_effort to 0
    let orbit_passes be number from ((payload_tally plus 3) divided by 4)
    give back approved_effort plus spillover_effort times 7 plus orbit_passes times 6

main.par.text:
include "logic.par"
a web_request has method as text, path as text, query as text, headers as map from text to text, body as text
a request_input has clearance_slug as text, pressurized_pods as number, vacuum_pods as number, docking_arms as number, solar_flare as yesno
a response_body has clearance_slug as text, payload_tally as number, transfer_effort as number, berth_allowance as number, approved_effort as number, spillover_effort as number, orbit_passes as number, clearance_rating as number, clearance_phase as text
a controlled_response has status as number, headers as map from text to text, body as response_body
a service_status has service as text, ready as yesno
to project_status giving service_status:
    give back a service_status with service "Orbital Cargo Clearance", ready yes
to empty_body with key as text, state as text giving response_body:
    give back a response_body with clearance_slug key, payload_tally 0, transfer_effort 0, berth_allowance 0, approved_effort 0, spillover_effort 0, orbit_passes 0, clearance_rating 0, clearance_phase state
to handle_request with request as web_request, body as request_input giving controlled_response:
    let headers be a map from text to text
    let credential be (maybe item "x-orbit-credential" of request's headers) otherwise ""
    if credential is not "orbit-046":
        set item "x-access-denial" of headers to "orbit_credential"
        give back a controlled_response with status 403, headers headers, body (empty_body with body's clearance_slug, "authorization_required")

logic.py.text:
from pydantic import BaseModel,ConfigDict
class RequestInput(BaseModel):
    model_config=ConfigDict(extra='forbid',strict=True); clearance_slug:str; pressurized_pods:int; vacuum_pods:int; docking_arms:int; solar_flare:bool
def score(pressurized_pods:int,vacuum_pods:int,docking_arms:int,solar_flare:bool)->int:
    total=pressurized_pods+vacuum_pods
    effort=pressurized_pods*8+vacuum_pods*14+(docking_arms*5 if solar_flare else 0)
    allowance=docking_arms*47
    approved=min(effort,allowance)
    spillover=max(effort-allowance,0)
    passes=(total+3)//4
    return approved+spillover*7+passes*6
def calculate(v:RequestInput)->dict[str,object]:
    total=v.pressurized_pods+v.vacuum_pods; effort=v.pressurized_pods*8+v.vacuum_pods*14+(v.docking_arms*5 if v.solar_flare else 0); allowance=v.docking_arms*47; spillover=max(effort-allowance,0)
    return {'clearance_slug':v.clearance_slug,'payload_tally':total,'transfer_effort':effort,'berth_allowance':allowance,'approved_effort':min(effort,allowance),'spillover_effort':spillover,'orbit_passes':(total+3)//4,'clearance_rating':score(v.pressurized_pods,v.vacuum_pods,v.docking_arms,v.solar_flare),'clearance_phase':'cleared' if spillover==0 else 'flare_hold' if v.solar_flare else 'routine_hold'}
